name: Standing Biceps Stretch
description: With your fingers interlaced behind your back and your arms straight, turn your palms down and lift your arms behind you to stretch the fronts of the upper arms, the chest and the shoulders.

source.title: Healthline: Bicep stretches (standing bicep stretch)
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Interlace your fingers behind you at the base of your spine.

prescription.note: Lift only until you feel a gentle stretch in the fronts of the arms; stand tall rather than leaning forward.

keyframes.name: Clasp your hands
keyframes.cue: Interlace your fingers behind you, arms straight, palms turned down.

keyframes.name: Standing Biceps Stretch
keyframes.cue: Lift your arms behind you until you feel the stretch.

keyframes.name: Release
keyframes.cue: Lower your arms and let go.
